verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents service keys for scripts/agents to interact with the workspace and an MCP server for AI assistants, implying some form of API for custom integrations, but there is no evidence of a documented API reference (OpenAPI/swagger) describing endpoints for pushing evidence or test results — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json/llms.txt all returned 404. Missing for 10: a public API reference/spec, example endpoints for evidence/test-result ingestion, and independent confirmation of custom integration use.
